title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
abstract: arXiv:2610.28562v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many scientific phenomena are best understood as outcomes of underlying optimization problems, yet automated scientific discovery has largely focused on recovering equations that describe observed input-output patterns. We introduce OptScientist, a novel automated framework for discovering compact symbolic optimization laws directly from data. OptScientist comprises (i) a model that infers symbolic optimization problems by first learning to represent data as an optimization problem and then extracting its symbolic form, and (ii) an LLM agentic system embedding the model in a discovery process that integrates theoretical priors from scientific literature, discovers candidate laws, abstracts their underlying mechanisms, and suggests new data to collect. translated_title: OptScientist：优化定律的自动化发现
translated_abstract: 许多科学现象最好被理解为底层优化问题的结果，然而自动化科学发现主要集中于恢复描述观测到的输入-输出模式的方程。我们提出了 OptScientist，这是一个新颖的自动化框架，用于直接从数据中发现简洁的符号优化定律。OptScientist 包含两个部分：(i) 一个推断符号优化问题的模型，它首先学习将数据表示为优化问题，然后提取其符号形式；(ii) 一个 LLM 智能体系统，将该模型嵌入到一个发现流程中，该流程整合来自科学文献的理论先验、发现候选定律、抽象其底层机制，并建议收集新的数据。我们首先在 OptFeynman 上评估 OptScientist，这是一个包含 99 个源自物理学的优化问题的新型基准，OptScientist 在超过 80% 的问题上成功恢复了真实定律，并且……
tldr: 提出了 OptScientist 框架，将符号优化问题推断模型与 LLM 智能体系统相结合，能够直接从数据中自动发现简洁的符号优化定律，并在包含 99 个物理优化问题的新型基准 OptFeynman 上对超过 80% 的问题成功恢复了真实定律。
en_tdlr: OptScientist is an automated framework that combines a symbolic optimization problem inference model with an LLM agentic system to discover compact symbolic optimization laws directly from data, recovering ground-truth laws for over 80% of problems in the new OptFeynman benchmark of 99 physics-derived optimization problems.
